item.title: China ready to share military building experience as PLA approaches centenary, says defense minister
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-16
BEIJING, Sept. 16 (Xinhua) -- Chinese Defense Minister Dong Jun said on Wednesday that the Chinese military stands ready to share its experience in building the armed forces as the People's Liberation Army (PLA) approaches its 100th anniversary. "As the Chinese military is about to mark its centenary, we are accelerating our modernization drive. We stand ready to share our experience and philosophy in building and governing the armed forces with all parties," Dong said at the opening ceremony of the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum. Dong added that the Chinese military is also willing to provide assistance to countries in need to the best of its ability. The PLA was founded in the Nanchang Uprising on Aug. 1, 1927, which marked the beginning of the Communist Party of China's independent leadership of the revolutionary war. Dong said that the Chinese military is also willing to work with all parties to deliver more tangible outcomes, and achieve mutual success and secure a win-win future through practical cooperation. In the face of sudden and frequent natural disasters, the Chinese military is willing to do its utmost and extend a helping hand where needed, Dong said. "We will actively carry out joint disaster relief early warning, emergency response, humanitarian assistance, and public security cooperation, and support the development and security of all countries through concrete actions," said Dong.

item.title: Senior military official calls for stronger China-Vietnam military cooperation
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-16
BEIJING, Sept. 16 (Xinhua) -- Senior Chinese military official Zhang Shengmin on Wednesday called for stronger practical cooperation between the Chinese and Vietnamese militaries. Zhang, vice chairman of the Central Military Commission, made the remarks when meeting with Vietnamese Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Phan Van Giang, who is in Beijing to attend the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum. Zhang said the Chinese and Vietnamese militaries should, guided by the important consensus reached by the top leaders of the two parties and countries, coordinate positions and enhance cooperation on major security issues in a timely manner, and work together to address global challenges. Zhang also called for continued efforts to take bilateral cooperation to a new level. Giang said Vietnam stands ready to work with China to advance more practical and effective defense and security cooperation. China and Vietnam enjoy a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership. In March, the first ministerial meeting of the China-Vietnam "3+3" strategic dialogue on diplomacy, defense and public security was held in the Vietnamese capital of Hanoi, followed by the 10th China-Vietnam border defense friendship exchange.

item.title: Xi congratulates Jilin University on 80th founding anniversary
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-16
BEIJING, Sept. 16 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday sent a congratulatory letter to Jilin University, celebrating its 80th founding anniversary. Xi, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, extended congratulations to the faculty, students and alumni of the university. He urged the university to carry forward the revolutionary traditions, leverage its comprehensive strengths, focus on the country's strategic needs, cultivate more high-caliber talent, and make greater contributions to the full revitalization of the Northeast in the new era and to advancing Chinese modernization.

item.title: China urges Philippines to abide by one-China principle: spokesperson
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-16
BEIJING, Sept. 16 (Xinhua) -- The Chinese side urged Philippines to abide by the one-China principle with concrete actions, and refrain from taking any steps that could harm China-Philippines relations, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said on Wednesday. Spokesperson Guo Jiakun made the remarks at a daily news briefing when asked to comment on media reports that the Taiwan authorities plans to set up a "representative office" in the central Philippine province of Cebu, which will serve as a platform to deepen ties through the "Taiwan-Philippines economic corridor." No matter how the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) authorities collude with external forces to seek "diplomatic breakthroughs" and advance their separatist agenda in whatever form, such attempts will be all in vain and doomed to fail, Guo added.

item.title: China urges U.S. to stop expanding military build-up in outer space: spokesperson
item.description:
Published: 2026-09-15
BEIJING, Sept. 15 (Xinhua) -- China urges the United States to stop expanding military build-up in outer space, and uphold global strategic stability with concrete actions, Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Tuesday. Guo made the remarks at a regular press briefing in response to the U.S. confirmation that it has weapons deployed in space. Guo added that China stands for peaceful use of outer space and keeping it safe, and opposes any arms race in outer space or any attempt to weaponize it and turn it into a war zone.
